## Brand & Style

This design system delivers an enterprise-grade B2B/B2C marketplace tailored for high-trust technology procurement, SaaS distributions, and technical vendor ecosystems in the Persian-speaking market. The aesthetic blends **Modern Corporate SaaS** rigor with frictionless marketplace discovery.

### Target Audience & Psychology
- **Audience:** CTOs, enterprise procurement officers, Iranian tech founders, and software vendors seeking vetted cloud, API, AI, and enterprise software solutions.
- **Tone:** Authoritative, pristine, technologically advanced, and scrupulously transparent.
- **Emotional Impact:** Immediate operational clarity, transactional confidence, institutional stability, and contemporary digital fluency.

### Stylistic Directives
- **Strict Light Mode Philosophy:** Grounded exclusively in radiant white (`#FFFFFF`) planes against cool slate surfaces (`#F8FAFC`, `#F1F5F9`). Dark mode is intentionally omitted to maintain strict corporate document-like legibility and high contrast.
- **RTL-First Spatial Harmony:** Native bidirectional architecture (`dir="rtl"`) with natural rightward scanning anchors, mirrored visual iconography, contextual back/forward navigation, and deliberate Persian typographical balance.
- **Structural Precision:** Clean 1px architectural boundary lines, layered atmospheric depth, modular content chunks, and purposeful data density.

## Colors

The palette establishes an unshakeable enterprise presence, utilizing deep technical indigos paired with functional innovation accents and rigorous status indicators.

### Key Tokens & Functional Mapping
- **Primary Anchor (`#2563EB` / `#1E3A8A`):** Anchors core calls to action, high-priority navigation links, primary tabs, and platform-wide interactive focus boundaries.
- **Secondary Accent (`#0D9488`):** Denotes technological intelligence, autonomous systems, AI integration labels, verified solution guarantees, and active feature toggles.
- **Tertiary Accent (`#7C3AED`):** Reserved for elite tier vendor tiers, enterprise SLA indicators, and featured technological showcases.
- **Highlight Warm Amber (`#D97706`):** Dedicated to verified customer satisfaction ratings, review counts, escrow notices, and promotional tags.

### Surfaces & Neutrals
- **Canvas Base:** `#F8FAFC` (Slate 50) - Subtle backdrop that separates structural panels.
- **Surface Layer (Cards, Modals):** `#FFFFFF` (Pure White) - Elevates data readability.
- **Secondary Surface:** `#F1F5F9` (Slate 100) - Segmented controls, input wells, and table header rows.
- **Structural Borders:** `#E2E8F0` (Slate 200) - Refined 1px dividers and card boundaries.
- **Text Headings:** `#0F172A` (Slate 900) - Uncompromising contrast for Persian script clarity.
- **Text Body:** `#334155` (Slate 700) - Sustained legibility across multi-paragraph documentation.
- **Text Muted & Labels:** `#64748B` (Slate 500) - Clear metadata, breadcrumbs, and placeholder guidance.

### System Feedback States
- **Success / Published:** `#059669` (Surface: `#ECFDF5`, Border: `#A7F3D0`)
- **Warning / Review:** `#D97706` (Surface: `#FFFBEB`, Border: `#FDE68A`)
- **Error / Rejected:** `#DC2626` (Surface: `#FEF2F2`, Border: `#FECACA`)
- **Informational / Draft:** `#0284C7` (Surface: `#F0F9FF`, Border: `#BAE6FD`)

## Typography

The typography stack relies exclusively on `Vazirmatn`, the standard for contemporary, highly legible Persian screen typography.

### Typographic Principles for Persian RTL
- **Elevated Vertical Metrics:** Persian glyphs exhibit substantial ascender and descender sweeps compared to Latin alphabets. Line heights are kept strictly between `1.6` and `1.8` across long-form content to avert glyph collisions and optical congestion.
- **Numeral Rendering:** Pricing metrics, vendor SLAs, and tabular values must enforce Eastern Arabic/Persian glyphs (`۰ ۱ ۲ ۳ ۴ ۵ ۶ ۷ ۸ ۹`) alongside standard financial suffixes (تومان / ریال), retaining numeric flow natively within RTL reading vectors.
- **Hierarchy & Weights:** Avoid light font weights (`< 400`) in UI elements due to subpixel rendering degradation in complex Perso-Arabic curves. Core interface anchors use `600` (SemiBold) and `700` (Bold), preserving legibility at micro sizes.

## Layout & Spacing

A strictly proportional, responsive 8-point base grid structure engineered for dense marketplace inventory, multi-layered filtering, and technical specification comparison matrices.

### Breakpoint Matrix
- **Mobile (< 768px):** 4-column layout, `1rem` margins, stacked filter sheets, full-width transactional CTAs.
- **Tablet (768px - 1023px):** 8-column layout, `1.5rem` margins, collapsible off-canvas filter rails, 2-column solution grids.
- **Desktop (1024px - 1439px):** 12-column layout, `2rem` margins, fixed 280px right-hand filtration sidebar, 3-column product cards.
- **Wide Display (≥ 1440px):** 12-column bounded canvas (max-width: 1400px centered), `3rem` margins, 4-column product matrix.

### RTL Flow & Structural Alignment
- Content origins start strictly on the **right edge**. Margins flow naturally inward from right to left.
- Interactive navigation paths (breadcrumbs, stepped wizards, sequential workflows) cascade from right to left. Chevron transitions and icon pointers point leftwards (`ChevronLeft`) to represent forward progression.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses a refined layering system composed of cool-slate tinted shadows, subtle borders, and pristine white surfaces to produce tactile elevation without heavy dark planes.

### Layer Hierarchy
- **Level 0 (Flat / Canvas):** `#F8FAFC` base background. Zero elevation.
- **Level 1 (Structural Cards / Panels):** Pure white `#FFFFFF` surface with `1px solid #E2E8F0` and `box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03)`.
- **Level 2 (Hover State / Elevated Modules):** Triggered on card hover or active workspace cards: `box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03)` accompanied by a subtle border shift to `#CBD5E1`.
- **Level 3 (Dropdowns / Flyout Filters / Tooltips):** `box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)` with `1px solid #E2E8F0`.
- **Level 4 (Modals / Checkout Sheets):** Backdrop blur `backdrop-filter: blur(4px)` over `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.35)` with `box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.20)`.

## Shapes

The design system maintains a modern, balanced curvature standard (`Level 2 - Rounded`). This gives software components an approachable, polished silhouette while keeping the structural rigidity required for high-density enterprise interfaces.

### Curvature Tokens
- **Micro Radii (`0.375rem` / `6px`):** Checkboxes, radio outer rings, subtle micro badges, and inner table cells.
- **Standard Radii (`0.5rem` / `8px`):** Input fields, standard buttons, dropdown selectors, metadata pill containers.
- **Component Radii (`0.75rem` / `12px`):** Product cards, modular containers, analytics summaries, side panels.
- **Overlay Radii (`1rem` / `16px`):** Dialog modals, bottom drawer sheets, mega menus.
- **Pill Radius (`9999px`):** Interactive tag filters, live status indicators, counter badges.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Background `#2563EB`, text `#FFFFFF`, font-weight `600`. Hover: `#1D4ED8`, active: `#1E40AF`. Subtle inner highlight border. Loading state replaces text with a spinner positioned adjacent to right-hand button labels.
- **Secondary / Subtle:** Background `#FFFFFF`, text `#0F172A`, border `1px solid #E2E8F0`. Hover: `#F8FAFC`, border color `#CBD5E1`.
- **Accent AI / Innovation:** Background `#0D9488`, text `#FFFFFF`. Hover: `#0F766E`.
- **Destructive:** Background `#FEF2F2`, text `#DC2626`, border `1px solid #FECACA`. Hover: `#FEE2E2`.

### Cards & Marketplace Solution Tiles
- **Default Structure:** Background `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid #E2E8F0`, corner radius `12px`. Padding: `1.25rem`.
- **Header Slot:** Right-aligned vendor logo (48x48px, rounded 8px), vendor title, and verified check badge. Left-aligned pricing unit in Persian numerals.
- **Hover Micro-Elevation:** Smooth 200ms ease transition: translateY(-2px), border color shifts to `#93C5FD`, shadow transitions from Level 1 to Level 2.

### Search Inputs & Tag Filtration
- **Omni-Search Bar:** Minimum height `48px`, background `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid #CBD5E1`, padded icon slot on the right (`Search`), keyboard shortcut cue on the left (`Ctrl + K`).
- **Active Filter Chips:** Removable pills with subtle slate tint (`#F1F5F9`), text `#334155`, font size `12px`. Close cross icon positioned on the left side of the chip (following RTL reading direction).

### Status Badges
- **Shape & Dimensions:** Height `24px`, padding `0 10px`, rounded `9999px`, font-size `12px`, font-weight `500`.
- **Published / Verified:** Green text `#065F46`, background `#ECFDF5`, border `1px solid #A7F3D0`. Includes a 6px solid green dot right-aligned before the text.
- **Under Review:** Amber text `#92400E`, background `#FFFBEB`, border `1px solid #FDE68A`.
- **Draft:** Slate text `#475569`, background `#F1F5F9`, border `1px solid #E2E8F0`.

### Form Controls (RTL-Engineered)
- **Inputs & Selects:** Text right-aligned, placeholder right-aligned with `#94A3B8`. Helper text right-aligned below input. Focus state: ring `2px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2)` and border `#2563EB`.
- **Checkboxes & Radios:** Placed to the right of the associated descriptive label, with an `8px` left margin separating the control from text.
